description: This file defines an abstract class IOFactory in the PhpSpreadsheet library that provides static methods to create, identify, and load spreadsheet readers and writers, facilitating file input/output operations with various formats.

classes.name: IOFactory
classes.description: Abstract class providing static factory methods for creating and identifying spreadsheet readers and writers in the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: createWriter
methods.description: Creates an instance of a writer implementing IWriter for a given Spreadsheet object and specified writer type.

methods.name: createReader
methods.description: Creates an instance of a reader implementing IReader for a given reader type.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a Spreadsheet object from a file by automatically detecting the appropriate reader.

methods.name: identify
methods.description: Returns the detected file type based on the file's content or extension.

methods.name: createReaderForFile
methods.description: Creates an appropriate IReader object for a file by analyzing its content and extension.

methods.name: getReaderTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Guesses the reader type based on the file extension.

methods.name: registerWriter
methods.description: Registers a custom writer class for a specific writer type.

methods.name: registerReader
methods.description: Registers a custom reader class for a specific reader type.
